summary: Arcos Dorados Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, prepared under US GAAP. No transaction, tender, activist, restructuring or other special situation is disclosed; the exhibit is a routine quarterly earnings/interim reporting filing by the Latin American McDonald's franchisee. Reported figures: revenue $3.85B versus $3.41B, operating income $206.3M versus $254.8M, net income attributable $112.3M versus $186.9M, and basic/diluted EPS $0.53 versus $0.89. No deal terms, board recommendation or advisors are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
